question: Who was the first Indian to become WHO's Deputy Director General?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Soumya Swaminathan**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Soumya Swaminathan** is an Indian pediatrician and clinical scientist known for her extensive work in **tuberculosis research and public health.** 
• She became the **first Indian** to serve as the **Deputy Director General** of the **World Health Organization (WHO)** in **March 2017**. 
• As the Deputy Director General, she was responsible for **Programmes**, which included overseeing WHO's global health initiatives and policies.
